Vendored copy of chart.xkcd 1.1.13 (https://github.com/timqian/chart.xkcd,
MIT license), byte-identical to the npm package `chart.xkcd@1.1.13`
`dist/chart.xkcd.min.js` that the app loads from the CDN. Used only by

without network access.
